name: Electric-drive float32 family (25 signals)
layout: 4-byte big-endian IEEE-754 float32; Car Scanner formula FLOAT32(A,B,C,D)
primary_source: Car Scanner profile rows 51.ElDrive; raw payloads in data/odb_scanner.db
cross_check_source: Physical plausibility across 17 successful reads/timestamp; evDash confirms addressing but does not decode these floats
validation: Offline regression: re-decode the stored raw bytes with struct.unpack(">f"); then, in a later approved read-only phase, compare one or two values (0x4FAE coolant, 0x3E93 DC link) with ambient/cluster context. No new requests now.
notes: Root cause is explicit in the profile: FLOAT32(A,B,C,D) rows were registered as u16/10+1. 25 of 26 eldrive signals are affected; eldrive_odometer (0x086D) is a ByteSet and is not.

name: Pack current sign and documentation
layout: u24/u32 big-endian: (raw - 150000)/100 A; no final negation
primary_source: Car Scanner profile formula; raw 0x1E3D and 0x1E3E; vehicle-info HV current 0x035E
cross_check_source: 0x035E hv_battery_current (negative at rest) and BMS discharge counter growth while parked
raw_example: 0x1E3D 000248FD -> -2.43 A; 0x1E3E 000248FD -> -2.43 A; 0x035E FFED -> -1.9 A at the same timestamp
decoded_example: registry -2.43 A; Car Scanner formula would display +2.43 A; physical convention negative = discharge
validation: Do not invert yet. Compare 0x1E3D, 0x1E3E and 0x035E during a known charge and a known drive; check that the discharge counter rises while current is negative. Then fix the docstring/label, not the arithmetic.
notes: The 2026-10-19 suspicion that our decoder is inverted is probably wrong. The arithmetic agrees with the independent 0x035E HV current and with discharge-counter direction. Car Scanner/ABRP apply a final *-1 and therefore show the opposite sign. This is a documentation/display conflict, not evidence for changing the decoder.

name: 0x1E32 lifetime charge/discharge block (Ah + kWh)
layout: four big-endian u32 fields: Ah charge @0, Ah discharge @4 (signed), kWh charge @8, kWh discharge @12 (signed); 0.001820444 Ah/count, 116508.398/1e9 kWh/count
primary_source: Car Scanner profile rows SBI 0/4/8/12; spot2000 same four-field layout; raw 0x1E32
cross_check_source: Internal arithmetic: 58,196 Ah x ~420 V ~= 24,437 kWh; 4% charge/discharge difference is plausible
decoded_example: 58,196.5 Ah charge; -57,808.3 Ah discharge; 24,436.98 kWh charge; -23,459.86 kWh discharge; current decoder: 3,724.57 / 3,699.73 kWh from offsets 0/4
validation: Offline: add four-field decode with regression vectors. Live read-only later: one 0x1E32 read; confirm the four values move in the expected direction on charge/discharge.
notes: Current decoder reads the Ah counters at 0/4 but divides by the kWh divisor, so both the offsets and units are wrong. This is a high-confidence fix, but still gated on a proposed test and explicit approval.
